ahmedabad.name: IIM Ahmedabad
notes: 'Return on investment' uses the fee of the batch that graduated that year, so salary and fee match. It exists only for 2021, 2025 and 2026 because no fee source was found for the 2020-22 to 2022-24 batches.
Salary is MEP (maximum earning potential), IIMA's headline basis. Cash-only TGCC is shown where found. 2021 covers domestic offers only.
Placement figures are from IIMA's IPRS audited reports. The 2025 and 2026 offers/firms counts differ from the Annual Report 2024-25 text; the IPRS report is used here.
Faculty, PhD and student rows come from IIMA's NIRF filings, one per edition. They show the filing as submitted, not an independent count.
Research output was only readable for 2024-25. Earlier IIMA annual reports could not be opened, so the per-faculty research rows have one data point.
International faculty share was not found for any year.
dataFlags: Median 2023: IPRS extract shows ₹32.02 lakh (combined); Cracku shows ₹31.58 lakh. 2024 also reads ₹32.02 lakh. Check the 2023 and 2024 PDFs.
Median 2025: ₹34.59 lakh combined; ₹34.53 lakh domestic only. The combined figure is used.
NIRF tables show a different 'median salary' (₹27.6, 30, 31, 31 lakh for 2021-2024 graduates) from the IPRS MEP medians. They are not used because the basis is unclear.
2025 offers and firms: the Annual Report text says 489 offers and 142 firms; the IPRS report says 395 offers and 178 firms. IPRS is used.
Fee ₹30.4 lakh (Careers360, 2025) includes hostel and mess; the other fee figures are programme fee. It is not used.

bangalore.name: IIM Bangalore
bangalore.salaryBasis: CTC as reported by the institute
notes: Salary: IIMB does not state whether its median is CTC. IIM A's figures are maximum earning potential (MEP), so the two are not directly comparable.
2021-2024 medians are what IIMB filed with NIRF. 2025 and 2026 medians come from news sites; check them against IIMB's own placement report.
Return on investment exists only for 2025 and 2026 because no earlier fee was found.
Research rows use faculty listed in NIRF as the denominator. IIMB counts 'Articles in IIMB Journal List'; IIM A counts 'A*/A papers', so the two are not like for like.
International students jumped to 12 in the 2026 filing; the earlier columns were inferred from garbled tables.
Women faculty and international faculty were not found.
dataFlags: Median 2022: NIRF shows ₹31.5 lakh; Cracku shows ₹31.20 lakh. NIRF is used.
Students placed 2023: NIRF 502; Careers360 shows 512 in one table and 502 in another. 502 is used.
2025 placed (602) and offers (660) come from a news site and include PGPBA students, so they are not directly comparable with 2021-2024.
Mean salary 2022 of ₹33.82 lakh (Cracku) equals IIM A's 2022 mean exactly and was not used.
Salary basis (CTC versus another measure) is not stated by IIMB or the news sources. Do not compare it directly with IIM A's maximum-earning-potential figure.

calcutta.name: IIM Calcutta
calcutta.salaryBasis: CTC as reported by the institute
notes: Salary: IIMC does not state whether its median is CTC. IIM A's figures are maximum earning potential (MEP), so the two are not directly comparable.
2021-2023 medians are what IIMC filed with NIRF. 2024 is missing. 2025 and 2026 come from news sites; check IIMC's own placement report.

Research output and faculty PhD share were not found for any year, so metrics 3 and 4 are mostly 'n/a'. Faculty PhD share could come from IIMC's faculty profile pages; research from Scopus.
International students show 0 in every year; the column positions in the NIRF tables were inferred.
Women faculty and international faculty were not found.
dataFlags: Average salary 2022 to 2024: sources disagree (2022: 30.60 or 34.20; 2023: 35.07 or 34.20; 2024: 32.62 or 35.07). None used.
Median 2023 is ₹33.67 lakh in both NIRF and MBAUniverse. A Careers360 article repeats it for 2024, but it is the NIRF figure for 2022-23 graduates, so 2024 is left blank.
Faculty counts in NIRF: 91, 87, 86, 134, 105. The swings suggest different counting rules between filings.

Students placed: 2021-2023 are NIRF placed counts (about 520-540); 2024-2026 are students participating in final placements (about 460), which is a different measure. Do not read the drop as fewer students placed.
2025-27 fee is quoted as both ₹27.0 and ₹27.5 lakh by the same article.

ranchi.name: IIM Ranchi
ranchi.salaryBasis: CTC as reported by the institute
notes: Salary is CTC as the institute reports it. IIM A's figures are maximum earning potential (MEP), so the two are not directly comparable.
Return on investment is blank for every year: only the 2025-27 batch fee was found, and that batch graduates in 2027.
Faculty doubled between 2021 and 2026 (42 to 98), so per-faculty research figures are affected by recent hiring.
Research counts all journal articles with no quality filter. IIM A's 'A*/A papers' and IIM Bangalore's 'Journal List articles' are stricter, so the three are not like for like.
Women faculty, international faculty and offer counts were not found.
dataFlags: Highest 2023 package: ₹67 lakh in one table and ₹35.5 lakh in another (international vs domestic). Not used here.
2025 mean: ₹19.24 lakh in the annual report, ₹19.29 lakh on Cracku. The annual report figure is used.

Students placed: 2021-2022 are NIRF placed counts; 2023 is a 'total students' count that probably includes other programmes; 2024-2026 count MBA participants only (about 215-220). Do not read the changes as growth or decline.
PG student totals from NIRF: 830 (2023), 864 (2024), 732 (2025), 756 (2026). The swings suggest the filings count different groups.
Journal articles 2026 (134) comes from a summary row with six numbers for seven labels, so the mapping may be off.
